content:
maria: Drafting the internal RN for tonight's runtime roll. Putting a short announce + playbook here for quick review.

maria: TL;DR: runtime v2.3.2 -> kernel selector fix, smarter KV cache reuse, and a tweak to continuous batching. Affects hosted + dedicated. No model weights or model version changes.

maria: Proposed internal snippet to post: 
```
Heads-up: Tonight at 02:00 UTC we'll roll runtime v2.3.2 (kernel selector + batching/KV caching). Expected: reduced tail latency for long-context calls and fewer cold-token spikes.
Canary plan: 3% for 15m -> 15% for 30m -> 100% if green. Dedicated pools will be pinned to runtime:v2.3.2 during the window.
Rollback triggers: >=4 OOMs in 10m OR error rate >2.0% sustained for 5m OR P95 latency +40% for 10m -> rollback to v2.3.1.
If rollback: run `./infra/bin/rollback-runtime --to v2.3.1` and escalate in #eng-sre.
Notes: No model weight/version changes. If customers have custom kernels or manual variant-locks, support must be notified to coordinate.
```

jamal: 3% seems low for heavy-node customers. Can we gate by customer tier? :thinking:

noah: we can do tiered canary via routing flag — start with 3% global, but restrict node-heavy accounts to 0% until 15% phase. Means less blast to legacy quantized pools.

maria: good idea. Update snippet to call out "node-heavy tiers held back until 15% phase". Also adding support contact line: support+dedicated@redwood.ai.

ops-oncall: Rollback checklist (short):
- >=4 GPU/CPU OOMs across any region in a 10m window -> immediate rollback.
- Error rate >2.0% sustained for 5m -> trigger canary rollback.
- P95 latency +40% vs baseline for 10m -> page SRE (@oncall).
- If rollback: `./infra/bin/rollback-runtime --to v2.3.1 --reason "canary-fail"` then notify #eng-sre and #support, include deploy link.
- Manual hold: ops can run `./infra/bin/hold-deploy --release 6460001111` to pause rollout.

maria: added the hold command and support email.

jamal: small ask: include staging verification link for QA to run quick smoke tests after canary start.

maria: added staging smoke URL: https://qa.internal/runs/643999-smoke. QA owner: noah.

deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] runtime:v2.3.2 -> rolling canary at 2026-10-12T02:00:00Z; owner: maria; plan: 3% x15m -> 15% x30m -> full. Link: https://deploys.internal/release/6460001111

noah: I'll run the smoke checks at +7m and +20m and post results.

jamal: RN nit: replace "No model weights or model version changes" -> "No model weights, model versions, or embedding pipelines changed" to be explicit.

maria: done. Final RN posted to #eng-releases and will be copied to #staff-announce 30m before deploy. Thanks for the quick reviews :thumbsup:
